title: The support of a finite type quasi-coherent module is closed, locally the zero locus of the annihilator
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $\mathcal F$ a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module of finite type [pqf-def-coherent], with support $\operatorname{Supp}(\mathcal F)=\{x\in X:\mathcal F_x\neq0\}$ [def-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base](2), $\mathcal F_x$ the stalk [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk]. Let $U\subseteq X$ be an affine open, $A=\mathcal O_X(U)$, $M=\mathcal F(U)$ (a finitely generated $A$-module), and identify $U$ with $\operatorname{Spec}A$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], the point $x\in U$ corresponding to the prime $\mathfrak p_x\subseteq A$. Then $\mathcal F_x\cong M_{\mathfrak p_x}$, and $x\in\operatorname{Supp}(\mathcal F)$ if and only if $\operatorname{Ann}_A(M)=\{a\in A: aM=0\}\subseteq\mathfrak p_x$; that is, $\operatorname{Supp}(\mathcal F)\cap U=V(\operatorname{Ann}_A(M))$. Consequently $\operatorname{Supp}(\mathcal F)$ is a closed subset of $X$.

source.place: Morphisms, Lemma 056J (morphisms-lemma-support-finite-type) part (1), via Lemma 056I (morphisms-lemma-support-affine-open), Properties Lemma 01PB (properties-lemma-finite-type-module) and Algebra Lemma 00L2 (algebra-lemma-support-closed, literature/stacks-project/algebra.tex) as in its proof
